options.label: 保持照片中的体型
options.prompt: Preserve the body shape and natural proportions visible in the full-body reference photo, except for regions explicitly overridden below.

options.label: 纤细
options.prompt: Use a slender narrow-framed body with visibly slim torso, upper arms, thighs and calves, without exaggerating leg length or making the waist unnaturally small.

options.label: 适中
options.prompt: Use a medium-size body with moderate torso and limb volume and ordinary natural proportions.

options.label: 饱满
options.prompt: Use a distinctly fuller soft-bodied physique with greater volume across torso, upper arms, abdomen, hips, thighs and calves. Retain natural fullness instead of automatically slimming the person.

options.label: 健壮
options.prompt: Use a strong athletic physique with greater shoulder, upper-back, arm and thigh muscle volume, without turning the person into a competitive bodybuilder.

options.label: 肩部较窄
options.prompt: Shoulder-specific override: relatively narrow shoulder breadth; do not reduce the hips or other body regions merely to match.

options.label: 肩部较宽
options.prompt: Shoulder-specific override: relatively broad shoulders and upper back; do not widen the waist or hips merely to match.

options.label: 腰线较明显
options.prompt: Waist-specific override: a noticeably defined waist relative to chest and hips, while retaining the selected overall body volume.

options.label: 腰腹较饱满
options.prompt: Waist-specific override: a naturally fuller abdomen with a softer and less tapered waist. Do not flatten the abdomen or automatically cinch the waist.

options.label: 臀部较窄
options.prompt: Hip-specific override: relatively narrow hips, without changing shoulder breadth or overall body volume elsewhere.

options.label: 臀部较丰满
options.prompt: Hip-specific override: wider fuller hips and fuller upper thighs, while retaining the selected shoulder and waist shape.

options.label: 上身偏长 · 腿偏短
options.prompt: Proportion-specific override: a relatively longer torso and shorter legs at the same overall height. Do not achieve this by cropping the feet or changing camera perspective.

options.label: 腿偏长 · 上身偏短
options.prompt: Proportion-specific override: relatively longer legs and a shorter torso at the same overall height, without extreme fashion-illustration proportions or a changed camera angle.
